paragraphs: A Jaguar AJ25 engine rebuild starts from £3,200, with exact pricing depending on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required.
A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available - submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Jaguar already has instead - strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most AJ25 owners choose, and it's the one we'd recommend for most situations.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting - sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call - particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries. Enter your reg below and we'll talk you through both options honestly.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild - a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle - restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers. Reconditioned / Refurbished / Remanufactured / Rebuilt - Terminology Explained Rebuilt: Existing engine stripped, inspected and rebuilt to original specification. Reconditioned: Broad industry term; we define our rebuild as a full strip and rebuild. Remanufactured: Usually implies a defined restoration process; our rebuild meets this standard. Used: Existing engine from another vehicle; we can source and fit these. What Jaguar Garage Means by "Rebuild": Full strip-down, inspection, measurement, machining where required, replacement of worn components, reassembly, testing, and refit - with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

faqLeft.q: What is the Jaguar AJ25 engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ25 is a 2.5-litre V6 petrol engine derived from Ford's Duratec family, produced from 2001 to 2009 and fitted exclusively to the Jaguar X-Type.

faqLeft.q: Which Jaguar models use the AJ25?
faqLeft.a: The AJ25 is fitted exclusively to the X-Type (X400 generation, 2001-2009) in both saloon and estate body styles.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar AJ25 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on AJ25 rebuilds across all X-Type applications, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: What's the difference between the AJ25 and AJ30?
faqLeft.a: The AJ25 is a 2.5-litre V6 producing 194-201 hp, while the AJ30 is a 3.0-litre V6 producing 238-240 hp. Both share the same Ford Duratec-derived architecture and 60-degree V6 configuration.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an AJ25 from an X-Type estate?
faqRight.a: Yes. Both saloon and estate X-Type applications use the same AJ25 engine specification.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Jaguar AJ25 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Jaguar if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AJ25 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most AJ25 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
